business_problem: Best Buy wanted to improve customer support and employee assistance at a time when shoppers expected faster, more personalized service, but the company needed a scalable self-service channel and better tools for care agents without losing empathy or relevance in support interactions.
solution_summary: Best Buy worked with Accenture and Google to deploy generative AI across both self-service and agent-assisted support journeys. The front-end experience is a gen AI-powered virtual assistant available on BestBuy.com, in the Best Buy app, and through customer-support channels, where it helps people troubleshoot products, change delivery or scheduling details, and manage software, Geek Squad, and membership-related tasks. When a request needs a human, the assistant passes the interaction to care agents who use gen AI tools that analyze conversations in real time, recommend relevant responses, suggest solutions, and surface the next best guidance for the case. Additional AI capabilities automate routine work such as navigating knowledge bases and detecting sentiment from calls so recurring issues can be prevented. The architecture blends self-service automation, human escalation, and real-time agent assist to make service more convenient for customers and more efficient for support teams.

solution_components.name: gen AI-powered virtual assistant
solution_components.role: Provides self-service support across digital and customer-contact channels for troubleshooting, order changes, and subscription management.

solution_components.name: gen AI tools
solution_components.role: Assist care agents in real time by recommending responses, guidance, and solutions during live conversations.

solution_components.name: knowledge bases
solution_components.role: Supply reference information that AI tools navigate automatically so agents can spend less time searching for answers.

solution_components.name: sentiment detection
solution_components.role: Analyzes support calls to identify tone and recurring issues that can be addressed more proactively.

data_flow: Customers start support requests through the website, mobile app, or contact channels, where the gen AI-powered virtual assistant handles common tasks and questions. If a case needs escalation, the interaction is handed to care agents whose AI tools analyze the live conversation, pull guidance from knowledge bases, detect sentiment, and recommend next actions so the issue can be resolved faster and more consistently.
business_outcome: Best Buy created a more personalized and convenient support experience for customers while giving agents faster access to recommendations and information, helping the company improve service efficiency and let employees focus on more meaningful interactions.

Sentiment and call data are used to prevent similar issues in the future.
